title: All Items
intro: Every weapon, tool, upgrade and story reward, with where to get it and what it needs. Grouped by Child Link, Adult Link and general items.
source_note: Written for this app. Locations and requirements follow the Ocarina of Time remake.

entries.title: Kokiri Tunic
entries.steps: Young Link's default outfit. You wear it from the start.

entries.title: Kokiri Sword
entries.steps: Take it from the Training Grounds in Kokiri Forest. The story needs it. It is Young Link's only sword and hits weakly.

entries.title: Deku Shield
entries.steps: Buy it at the Kokiri Forest Item Shop for 40 Rupees. The story needs it. Fire destroys it.

entries.title: Deku Stick
entries.steps: Dropped by a Deku Baba you kill while it stands upright. Default capacity is 10. Touch one to fire to use it as a torch; it burns out after a while.

entries.title: Deku Nut
entries.steps: Dropped by a Deku Baba you hit in the face as it lunges. Default capacity is 20. It stuns some enemies and bosses, Gohma included.

entries.title: Fairy Slingshot
entries.steps: Found inside the Great Deku Tree. Default Deku Seed capacity is 30. It unlocks the Castle Town Shooting Gallery.

entries.title: Kokiri Emerald
entries.steps: Awarded automatically when you finish the Great Deku Tree.

entries.title: Fairy Ocarina
entries.steps: Saria gives it to you as you leave Kokiri Forest. Story progress only.

entries.title: Empty Bottle #1
entries.steps: Help the frightened shopkeeper in the Castle Town Potion Shop catch the loose Bug. This Bottle is new to the remake.

entries.title: Zelda's Letter
entries.steps: Zelda gives it to you when you speak with her at Hyrule Castle. Show it to the Gate Guard in Kakariko Village to open the way up Death Mountain.

entries.title: Empty Bottle #2
entries.steps: Win Talon's Super Cucco mini-game in the ranch house.

entries.title: Bigger Deku Seed Bag
entries.steps: Win the Castle Town Shooting Gallery. The two Seed Bag upgrades can come in either order.

entries.title: Biggest Deku Seed Bag
entries.steps: In the Lost Woods, go right from the entrance and hit the Deku Scrub target's bullseye three times. The two Seed Bag upgrades can come in either order.

entries.title: Bigger Deku Stick Bag
entries.steps: From the Lost Woods entrance go right, then right again, and find the grotto at the dead end. The Business Scrub there sells it for 40 Rupees.

entries.title: Biggest Deku Stick Bag
entries.steps: Wear the Skull Mask in front of the Scrubs at the Forest Stage in the Lost Woods.

entries.title: Hylian Shield
entries.steps: Young Link can find one free in a Graveyard grotto. Otherwise buy it in Castle Town for 80 Rupees, or 60 if you showed Zelda's Letter to the Kakariko guard first. Adult Link can use it fully; Young Link can only crouch-guard with it.

entries.title: Empty Bottle #3
entries.steps: Return all the loose Cuccos to their pen in Kakariko Village.

entries.title: Adult's Wallet
entries.steps: With 10 Gold Skulltula Tokens, talk to the Cursed Rich Man in the Kakariko Spider House.

entries.title: Goron Bracelet
entries.steps: Play Saria's Song for Darunia in Goron City. The story needs it. It lets you pick up Bomb Flowers.

entries.title: Bombs
entries.steps: Found inside Dodongo's Cavern.

entries.title: Goron Ruby
entries.steps: Awarded automatically when you finish Dodongo's Cavern.

entries.title: Din's Fire
entries.steps: Offer 25 Rupees to the Great Fairy on Death Mountain. The spell engulfs everything near Link in flames and is needed to open the Shadow Temple.

entries.title: Gift of Improved Spin
entries.steps: Optional. Offer 50 Rupees to the Great Fairy at Hyrule Castle (her fountain is opened with Bombs). Charge a spin by holding the attack button, or spin the stick and then attack.

entries.title: Bombchu
entries.steps: Optional. Win the Bombchu Bowling mini-game in Castle Town.

entries.title: Echo Gem
entries.steps: With 20 Gold Skulltula Tokens, talk to the Cursed Rich Man. Equipped, it pings and flashes when a Gold Skulltula is close.

entries.title: Bigger Deku Nut Bag
entries.steps: Blow up the boulder beside the Sacred Grove entrance with a Bomb and enter the grotto. The Business Scrub sells it for 40 Rupees.

entries.title: Biggest Deku Nut Bag
entries.steps: Wear the Mask of Truth in front of the Scrubs at the Forest Stage in the Lost Woods.

entries.title: Bigger Bomb Bag
entries.steps: Stop the rolling Goron near the sign in one of the middle-level tunnels. Stand at the tunnel mouth until he comes into view, pull out a Bomb, then run to the sign so it goes off as he passes.

entries.title: Biggest Bomb Bag
entries.steps: Win Bombchu Bowling a second time.

entries.title: Magic Beans
entries.steps: Optional. Buy them from the Bean Seller in Zora River. His stock is limited and each bean costs more than the last. Plant them in soil patches as Young Link; a floating platform appears in the adult era, often leading to Rupees, Gold Skulltulas or Pieces of Heart.

entries.title: Silver Scale
entries.steps: Earn it from the Diving Lesson mini-game in Zora's Domain. The story needs it. It lets you dive deep enough to reach Ruto's Letter.

entries.title: Empty Bottle #4 (Ruto's Letter)
entries.steps: Lies on an underwater platform in Lake Hylia, straight ahead from the shortcut coming from Zora's Domain. Show the letter to King Zora to open Zora's Fountain. The story needs it.

entries.title: Farore's Wind
entries.steps: Optional. Make a 100 Rupee offering at the Zora's Fountain Great Fairy Fountain. It sets a return point inside a dungeon, one at a time, that you can warp back to.

entries.title: Boomerang
entries.steps: Found inside Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly. It picks up distant items and is needed for many Gold Skulltulas.

entries.title: Zora Sapphire
entries.steps: Awarded automatically when you finish Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

entries.title: Giant's Wallet
entries.steps: With 30 Gold Skulltula Tokens, talk to the Cursed Rich Man.

entries.title: Ocarina of Time
entries.steps: After collecting all three Spiritual Stones, Zelda throws it into the Castle Town moat. Fetch it from there. Story progress only.

entries.title: Lens of Truth
entries.steps: Learn the Song of Storms as an adult and clear the Forest Temple, then return to the child era. Play the song at the Kakariko Windmill to open the Well. The Lens is inside Bottom of the Well. It reveals false walls and hidden secrets.

entries.title: Hero's Clothes
entries.steps: Adult Link's default outfit.

entries.title: Master Sword
entries.steps: Play the Song of Time at the altar in the Temple of Time after gathering the three Spiritual Stones. It is Adult Link's weapon, stronger and longer than the Kokiri Sword.

entries.title: Light Medallion
entries.steps: Awarded automatically when you pull the Master Sword.

entries.title: Epona
entries.steps: Beat Ingo in a horse race at Lon Lon Ranch. You can do this as soon as you become Adult Link.

entries.title: Hookshot
entries.steps: Win the Dampe Race in the Graveyard. The story needs it. It pulls you to vines, chains and grates, grabs distant items, and now also hits eye switches.

entries.title: Fairy Bow
entries.steps: Found inside the Forest Temple. It unlocks the Kakariko Shooting Gallery and Gerudo Fortress Horseback Archery.

entries.title: Forest Medallion
entries.steps: Awarded automatically when you finish the Forest Temple.

entries.title: Bigger Quiver
entries.steps: Win the Kakariko Shooting Gallery.

entries.title: Empty Bottle #5
entries.steps: Earn 500 points at the Castle Town Poe Shop. Each Great Poe is worth 100 points; ride Epona over the purple glowing obstacles in Hyrule Field to find them.

entries.title: Goron Tunic
entries.steps: Buy it in the Goron City shop for 600 Rupees, or get it free by bombing the Goron named Link, stopping his roll, and finishing his dialogue. The story needs it. It protects you from intense heat.

entries.title: Megaton Hammer
entries.steps: Found inside the Fire Temple. It presses heavy switches and smashes volcanic rock, opening areas like the Death Mountain Crater Great Fairy Fountain.

entries.title: Fire Medallion
entries.steps: Awarded automatically when you finish the Fire Temple.

entries.title: Gift of Doubled Magic
entries.steps: Optional. Make a 200 Rupee offering at the Death Mountain Crater Great Fairy Fountain.

entries.title: Iron Boots
entries.steps: Found in the Ice Cavern, reached from the frozen Zora's Fountain. The story needs it. It sinks you to the bottom of any water. Use it straight away to grab the Piece of Heart at the bottom of Zora's Fountain.

entries.title: Zora Tunic
entries.steps: Buy it in the Zora's Domain shop, or get it free by melting the Red Ice around King Zora with Blue Fire from the Ice Cavern. The story needs it. It lets you breathe underwater.

entries.title: Longshot
entries.steps: Found inside the Water Temple. It doubles the Hookshot's reach, opening new areas and Gold Skulltulas.

entries.title: Water Medallion
entries.steps: Awarded automatically when you finish the Water Temple.

entries.title: Fire Arrow
entries.steps: From the center island of Lake Hylia, shoot the ring of light at sunrise. The arrows land on a nearby island; swim over and pick them up. Easiest after the Water Temple.

entries.title: Golden Scale
entries.steps: Optional. Catch a large fish at the Lake Hylia Fishing Pond. It doubles your dive depth, enough to reach the Piece of Heart in the Lakeside Laboratory tank. Easiest after the Water Temple.

entries.title: Biggoron Sword
entries.steps: Optional. Finish the Pocket Egg trading sidequest. It is Link's strongest sword, hitting harder and farther but swinging slower. See the How-To Guides entry for the full chain.

entries.title: Hover Boots
entries.steps: Found inside the Shadow Temple.

entries.title: Shadow Medallion
entries.steps: Awarded automatically when you finish the Shadow Temple.

entries.title: Gerudo Pass
entries.steps: Free all the carpenters in Gerudo Fortress and impress the Gerudo Captain. The story needs it. It grants free entry to the Fortress, the Proving Grounds and Horseback Archery.

entries.title: Biggest Quiver
entries.steps: Win the Horseback Archery mini-game at Gerudo Fortress.

entries.title: Ice Arrow
entries.steps: Optional. Reward for clearing the Proving Grounds. It can freeze Bongo Bongo's hands and leave him open at once.

entries.title: Nayru's Love
entries.steps: Optional. Make a 300 Rupee offering at the Desert Colossus Great Fairy Fountain.

entries.title: Silver Gauntlets
entries.steps: Found in the child-era half of the Spirit Temple. It lets you lift and throw the black Ganon pillars.

entries.title: Mirror Shield
entries.steps: Found in the adult-era half of the Spirit Temple.

entries.title: Spirit Medallion
entries.steps: Awarded automatically when you finish the Spirit Temple.

entries.title: Light Arrow
entries.steps: Zelda gives them to you when you visit the Temple of Time with all six medallions. Story progress only.

entries.title: Golden Gauntlets
entries.steps: Found in the Shadow section of Ganondorf's Castle. It lets you lift the golden Ganon pillars, such as the one blocking the Great Fairy Fountain outside the castle.

entries.title: Gift of Halved Damage
entries.steps: Optional. Make a 500 Rupee offering at the Great Fairy Fountain outside Ganondorf's Castle.

entries.title: Piece of Heart
entries.steps: There are 36 in the game. See the Heart Pieces guide for every one.

entries.title: Gold Skulltula Token
entries.steps: There are 100 in the game. See the Gold Skulltulas guide for every one.

entries.title: Empty Bottle
entries.steps: There are 5 in the game. The entries above list each one.

entries.title: Business Scrub Seed
entries.steps: New in the remake. Found around the world and sold by Business Scrubs and some shops. Use it to call up a Business Scrub who sells you items.
